svg.title: NPC crowd meme
svg.desc: A crowd of identical grey NPC faces. One says: EVEN THOUGH I'M IN AN ORGANIZATION THAT'S ADVANCING CAPABILITIES FASTER THAN SAFETY AT A 30:1 RATIO, I'M THE GOOD GUY ON THE INSIDE, IF IT WEREN'T FOR ME IT WOULD BE 40:1

text.tspan: THE GOOD GUY ON THE INSIDE,
IF IT WEREN'T FOR ME IT
